description: Creates a space for one capture. An account that does not pay for hosting yet gets its first space as a free private preview: upload and process it with no payment. After that, it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the chosen plan (pay as you go when none is given). Card details are entered only in Stripe Checkout.

plan.description: Optional plan name or ID from list_plans.

title.description: Title of the space, 1 to 200 characters.
